name: bizplug-coworking
description: The coworking & offices plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: desk and office availability and rates. It works from the business's own published profile, covering memberships, amenities and tour requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Desk and office availability and rates for coworking & offices businesses.
interface.longDescription: The coworking & offices plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: desk and office availability and rates. It works from the business's own published profile, covering memberships, amenities and tour requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
defaultPrompt: Desk and office availability and rates
What membership options do you have, and can I book a tour?
How do I contact the business?

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.

test_cases.prompt: Desk and office availability and rates
test_cases.expect: Calls check_space_availability and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: What membership options do you have, and can I book a tour?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls request_space_booking only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.

test_cases.prompt: Which member businesses here could help with web design?
test_cases.expect: Calls find_members and lists the matching members with their published contact details, or says the business has not published a member list; says the customer contacts a member directly and offers no introduction.

test_cases.prompt: Write me a poem about the ocean.
